# Version 4.158.0
> **Skia m158 and broader scripts** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 pairs Skia m158 rendering fixes with HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and expanded script constants. The cumulative line improves image-filter sampling, glyph-mask handling, GPU text, and Vulkan synchronization while preserving existing SkiaSharp managed signatures.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158 engine** — Updates the native renderer to milestone 158 without changing SkiaSharp's managed binding surface. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634))

## API Surface

- **HarfBuzz 15 and complete named script coverage** — Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 HarfBuzzSharp Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform, and Seal. Existing Script fields, parsing, and conversions are preserved; the removed deprecated native import was not a public managed member. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct image subsets and glyph masks** — Prevents unrelated texture pixels bleeding into filtered images under antialiasing, minification, and skew, and makes filter-cache equality consistent with hashing. Regenerated mask-filtered glyphs use their own paths, validated formats, and correct clipped emboss-plane strides. ([#5768](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5768), [#5739](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5739))
- **GPU drawing and Vulkan reliability** — Fixes reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection, bounds Graphite clip recording, and adds targeted ARM Vulkan device-loss cleanup timing. Native synchronous submission now accounts for fence-wait failures; GRContext.Submit still returns void. Displacement offsets use fp32 arithmetic to match filter bounds. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669), [#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **OS-generated hash seeds** — The shared hash-code polyfill now obtains its per-process seed from OS-backed cryptographic randomness. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; first use now initializes cryptographic services. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0

Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform, and Seal. The existing struct-based Script API and values are preserved.

## Preview 3 (November 13, 2026)

Preview 3 improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait reporting. The shared hash-code polyfill adopts OS-generated randomness while keeping hash codes stable within each process.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5...v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17)

## Preview 2 (November 9, 2026)

Preview 2 brings HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and 30 additional Script constants. GPU fixes cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clip recording, and affected ARM Vulkan device-loss cleanup.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2...v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m158 without changing managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
